So far, so good! The Lancome Clarifique Pro-Solution has the consistency of a super light serum. I love the packaging and the dispenser. It automatically dispenses the perfect amount for each application, which is really innovative! I dispense the liquid into the palm of my hand and gently press it into my skin--both face and neck! It feels really lightweight upon application, but has a slight stickiness. The stickiness goes away after a few minutes, but just flagging for anyone who is curious. It has a really faint, pleasant smell. It also is a great first layer of skincare and doesn't pill up when applying moisturizer as the next layer, which is great! So far, I have just been applying it at night as part of my nighttime skincare routine, but it says you can use twice a day. I've used this product for a week, and can already see some reduction in the appearance of my pores. I have a few dark spots that I'm hopeful will lighten with continued use. I'm excited to see the results after using the entire bottle.
